name: Aurelius Collective Voile Dress Shirt — Port-Open
description: A crisp white voile dress shirt with a Mandarin-adjacent collar and mother-of-pearl resin buttons, cut to skim rather than drape. Pre-cut neural port openings at the standard C3 and C5 positions are finished with brushed titanium grommets so they read as intentional design elements rather than medical accommodations. Packaged unstarched; it holds a press for exactly one day.
functionality: Neural port access grommets at C3/C5, breathable voile weave for summer humidity, semi-spread collar.
what_it_says: Your augmentation is not something you hide — it's something you frame.
story_hooks: A batch shipped with grommet placements 4mm off-standard — wearers with precise port positions have been complaining loudly on the Aurelius community boards.
The voile is thin enough that a subdermal implant network is faintly visible through the fabric in certain lighting — some wearers consider this a feature.
